guide.arrived: A school-event notice has created child care for 陽菜 on 12/7 and a shirt to prepare. Tap “Decide” to compare each option's decision deadline and what happens if you choose it.
guide.asked: 彩 asked おばあちゃん and is waiting for the reply. 健太 has a task to buy the shirt at a shop on the way home (the store your family marked usual). Switch “Viewing as” to 彩 to try “What if they say no?”. Under “Around us” in Family, your family reviews places Claude found nearby and decides how each store is used.
guide.chase: おばあちゃん hasn't replied, and the after-school care deadline is close. On 彩's screen, Maniau asks whether to hold a backup, and “What if they say no?” shows the calculation if the answer is no.
guide.backup: After-school care is held as a backup. If おばあちゃん says no, the plan moves on to it (see “What if they say no?” on 彩's screen).
guide.postponed: A postponement notice means child care on 12/7 is no longer needed. The cancellations to send are split between the two adults.

needCheck.label: Check the reading
needCheck.windowNoEnd: someone is needed on {{day}} from {{from}} (no end time read)
needCheck.windowNoTime: someone is needed on {{day}} (no times read)
needCheck.noDate: someone is needed during a time (no date read)
needCheck.noDeadline: get it done by a deadline (no deadline read)
needCheck.noShape: could not tell whether someone is needed during a time or it must be done by a deadline
needCheck.notLive: With the current answer, this is not needed. If the condition doesn’t match the original text, remove it with “Misread”.
needCheck.past: The date and time read have already passed. Fix it if they are wrong; otherwise remove it.
needCheck.replaces: Read as replacing {{target}}. Until you confirm, the earlier one is treated as uncertain.
needCheck.cancels: Read as calling off {{target}}. Until you confirm, the earlier one is treated as uncertain.
needCheck.answers: Read as answering “{{label}}” with “{{value}}”. Until you confirm, this answer is not counted.
needCheck.flagged: Parts of this reading may not match the original text, or may have been missed. Check the date and times against the original text carefully.
needCheck.unshown: Part of this reading (its condition, an answer, or what it replaces) can’t be shown here in a way you can tell apart, so it can’t be confirmed. If it is needed, remove it with “Misread” and add it with “Add something to do”.
needCheck.body: This was read by the model, so it stays out of the plan until your family checks it (no tasks or messages are made). The bold text is what the reading is based on; check the rest of the notice too for anything that changes the date, time, or conditions.
needCheck.wholeNotice_one: Show the whole notice ({{count}} more sentence)
needCheck.wholeNotice_other: Show the whole notice ({{count}} more sentences)
needCheck.brief: Show only the sentences it is based on and their neighbors
needCheck.misreadNote: Once removed, this reading stays out of the plan (if it is needed, add it with “Add something to do”). If the notice is read again, you will be asked again.

input.label: Add a notice
input.help: Paste a notice from school or an activity, or speak it with your keyboard's microphone. Anything that can be planned becomes decisions and deadlines. What each sentence became is shown next to the original.
input.placeholder: e.g. Monday 12/7 is a normal school day. The presentation is postponed to Tuesday 12/8.
input.photoPrivacy: Photos and PDFs are sent to Anthropic's Claude API to estimate their size and to be transcribed. This app doesn't keep them. Try one that shows no names or places.
input.pdfNote: Transcribed from the PDF. Open the PDF to compare, fix anything that differs, then press "Read it".
input.tooLong: The text is too long ({{count}} characters; up to {{max}}). Delete what isn't needed, then press "Read it".
input.photoNote: Transcribed from the photo. Compare it with the photo, fix anything that differs, then press "Read it".

photoStatus.empty: No text could be read. Retake the photo in good light with the whole notice in frame.
photoStatus.tooLarge: Too large or too many pages (one photo, or a PDF of a few pages up to 4 MB). Keep only the pages you need.
photoStatus.unsupported: This format can't be opened. Choose a photo (JPEG, PNG, etc.) or a PDF.
photoStatus.unreadable: The file couldn't be read. Save it to your device, then choose it again.
photoStatus.limit: No transcriptions left. For this demo, use "Restart" for a new demo. The server-wide limit resets the next day (UTC).
photoStatus.busy: Another reading is in progress. Please wait a moment, then press "Send again".
photoStatus.uncertain: No answer came back. Press "Send again" (if it was already transcribed, it won't be read again; nothing was recorded).
photoStatus.failed: It couldn't be transcribed. Press "Send again", retake the photo, or paste the text.

input.privacy: What you enter is sent to Anthropic's Claude API to be read (to understand changes, the items already recorded in this demo, including what family members said, and open questions are sent too). Use made-up text, or remove anything that identifies a person or place (names, school names, addresses). In this demo the text is kept only in the server's memory, and demos left unused for more than 12 hours are deleted periodically.
input.limit: No readings left. For this demo, use "Restart" for a new demo. The server-wide limit resets the next day (UTC).
input.busy: Another reading is in progress. Please wait a moment and press again.
input.uncertain: We couldn't tell the result (no reply came, or recording stopped partway). Press again to check the earlier reading (if it was already added, it won't be added twice; if it wasn't read, it will be read again).
input.failed: It couldn't be read. Please check the text and try again.
input.clock: Words like “tomorrow” are read against the demo clock ({{now}}).
input.stale: While reading, items read earlier changed (corrected, confirmed, etc.). Please press "Read it" again. Your text is still here.
input.privacyTrial: This is a trial household. Enter made-up text only (don't enter real notices yet). What you enter is sent to Anthropic's Claude API to be read (to understand changes, the items already recorded in this household, including what family members said, and open questions are sent too; household settings are not sent; any names written in the text are sent as well). The text you read is kept in this household's records.
input.limitTrial: Can't read right now (the text is too long, or the limit was reached; the limit resets at 9:00 Japan time).
input.lost: We can't tell whether your earlier reading finished (the server may have stopped partway). Check the plan and the notice list; if it isn't there, press "Read it" again (it will be a new reading).
input.testOnly: Reading with Claude isn't available for this household (trial households only).
input.clockTrial: Words like “tomorrow” are read against the current time ({{now}}).

say.label: Quick update
say.privacy: Your update, this demo's (fictional) family and helper names, and the current items, tasks and requests (including the people and places involved) are sent to Anthropic. Don't include anything that identifies a person or place (names, school names, addresses).
say.privacySummary: Your update, the names of family and helpers, and current plans and requests are sent to Anthropic. Leave out words that identify people or places.
say.privacySummaryTrial: This is a trial household. Use made-up text only. Your update, the names of family and helpers, and current plans and requests are sent to Anthropic.
say.which: Which one do you mean? The one you tap is recorded.
say.whichUnknown: We couldn't tell which one you mean. Please say it again with the date or the person.
say.lookAlike: Some matches look the same, so they aren't offered. Please say it again with the date, time, or person.

blocked.otherTasks: There are other tasks, so a quick update doesn't record this (to avoid recording the wrong one). On Today, find the task's card and record it there.
blocked.otherRequests: There are other requests, so a quick update doesn't record this (to avoid recording the wrong one). On Today, find the request's card and record it there.
blocked.otherUnknowns: There are other questions this could answer, so a quick update doesn't record this answer (to avoid answering the wrong one). If there's a question card on Today, answer there.
blocked.needOnCard: In a trial household, replies to requests for a to-do, and telling someone such a request is cancelled, aren't recorded by a quick update (to avoid recording the wrong one). On Today, check what you sent on the request card and record it there.
blocked.missing: What this refers to isn't in the current plan. Please say it again.

say.unknownRequest: a request whose content is unknown
say.otherAdult: This looks like another adult's task. That person records changes such as not being able to do it or having done it.
say.unowned: One of these tasks has no one assigned yet. Choose who does it on the Today card first.

unsupported.routineChange: Ongoing changes, changes for several people or days, pick-up-only changes and working from home can't be taken from a message yet. For a single day, say whose day and which day (e.g. “What if I take 12/7 off?”).
unsupported.otherAdultsTask: This looks like another adult's task. That person records it.
unsupported.notInPlan: Nothing in the plan matches this.
unsupported.replyOrWhatIf: We couldn’t tell whether this is a real reply or a what-if. Say them separately, such as “Grandma says it’s fine” for a reply or “What if Grandma says no?” for a what-if.
unsupported.other: This update can't be recorded yet.

refused.routinePlace: A block's kind and place don't match (“Home” must be at home; “Out” and “Pick-up” must be somewhere else).
refused.hoursOvernight: Opening hours past midnight aren't supported yet (set the closing time after the opening time).

need.label: To do
need.stated: Your family said this (it is not from a notice).
need.written: This was written in a notice.

need.placeNote: We have not checked that someone will be at the written place, or the travel time.
need.options: Pick the way to go with

dismiss.label: Mark this as not needed
dismiss.note: If you mark it as not needed, accepted tasks are no longer needed and anyone you asked will need a cancellation message. Check what changes below before deciding.

ways.label: Ways to use
ways.none: Your family has no ways yet. You can add one with “Add a way” below.
ways.note: Choose from the ways your family registered. No tasks are made until you choose.
ways.changed: The details or the ways changed after you chose, so please choose again.
ways.noCover: Nobody covers the time (only steps done beforehand)
ways.stopped: This way has been stopped. You can keep it in this choice (once removed, it can’t be chosen again).

add.title: Add something to do
add.intro: Write what your family said, as it was said. The fields below are what the plan uses. Before saving, you will see what this changes.
add.window: Someone is needed during a time
add.by: Get it done by a deadline
add.byTime: Deadline time (empty: by the end of the day)
add.missing: Fill in what was said, what, and the date (and the start and end, for “someone is needed during a time”).

fix.title: Fix the reading
fix.intro: Fix the fields the plan uses, looking at the original text. Once saved, it goes into the plan as checked by your family.
fix.shape: Kind: {{shape}} (kept from the reading. If the kind is wrong, remove it with “Misread” on Today, then use “Add something to do”.)
fix.changed: This notice changed after it was shown. Please check it again on Today.
fix.conditionNote: The condition and answers can’t be changed here (they are confirmed as read). If they are wrong, remove the reading with “Misread” on Today.
fix.introPlanned: Edit the fields the plan uses. Before saving, you’ll see what this changes (choosing a way again, checking with anyone you asked, and so on).
fix.shapePlanned: Kind: {{shape}} (can’t be changed. If it’s wrong, mark this as not needed and use “Add something to do”.)
fix.conditionNotePlanned: The condition and answers can’t be changed here. If they are wrong, mark this as not needed and use “Add something to do”.
fix.changedPreview: The plan changed after you looked. Please check what this changes again.

refused.needWindowMissing: Enter the date and the start and end times.
refused.needWindowOvernight: Make the end later than the start on the same day (times across midnight are not supported yet).
refused.needMemberUnknown: Choose who it is for from your family.

refused.wayInactive: A stopped way can’t be newly chosen.

ways.label: Ways to get things done
ways.used: Your family chooses these for each thing to do. Before saving an addition, edit or stop, we show what the change would do.
ways.stopNote: Once stopped, it can’t be newly chosen. Anything that already uses it keeps its choice, tasks and requests.
ways.stopUsing: Chosen for “{{what}}”. To take it off, choose that item’s ways again.

way.intro: Describe, in your own words, how your family gets this kind of thing done. Leave anything you don’t know as “Not known” (we won’t treat it as zero or as “no deadline”). Before saving, we show what the change would do.
way.name: Name of the way
way.newToAddressAs: How to address them (optional; used in messages, e.g. Mum)
way.wait: Time to allow for a reply
way.waitOnly: Put time spent only waiting for a reply here. A separate step that is only waiting also counts as someone’s working time, so entering it in both places makes the times overlap.
way.waitAfterKept: Leaves {{min}} min before the next step (kept as is; not changed here)
way.waitDropped: With no one to ask, the {{min}} min allowed for a reply is removed too
way.placeHoursNote: If the place has no registered opening hours (or only hours from a map), we don’t check that you can go then, and we don’t suggest this way.
way.segments: When it can be done (which part of the usual day)
way.deadlineNone: No rule (by the item’s own deadline or start)
way.deadlineDays: By a time, some days before
way.deadlineBusinessDays: By a time, some business days before
way.deadlineOnTheDay: By a time on the day
way.cover: Whoever does this step (or the person asked) covers the time
way.coverNote: Only used for things that need someone during a set time.
way.coversNote: For example, care from 8:30 to 17:30. Leave empty if you don’t know (the other person’s “yes” confirms it).
way.costNote: Leave unknown costs as “Not known”. When a way’s cost isn’t known, we don’t suggest one.
way.missing: Some fields are still empty or not chosen: name, what to do in each step, fixed place, by when, when it can be done, minutes, costs (and, when asking someone, who and the time to allow for a reply; for Claude’s ideas, also who does it, whether it covers the time, and the hours covered).
way.coversWhole: The whole time of the to-do (confirmed by their “yes” or the family’s schedule)
way.coversPart: Only part of the time (enter it below)
way.coversAskNote: Claude couldn’t tell, so please choose. Choosing the whole time doesn’t mean anyone has agreed.
way.sameName: (another has the same name, so it can’t be newly chosen)
way.helpersDerived: The number of times you ask someone is counted from the steps’ contacts (it’s recounted when you change a contact; once you edit the number, it stops counting).

requires.label: Things to finish before using it (such as advance registration)
requires.note: A way with a prerequisite that isn’t done is marked and not suggested (you can still choose it). Choosing prerequisites doesn’t change who you ask or where you go.

copy.name: {{way}} ({{place}})
copy.label: A new way using a place near you
copy.intro: A new way copied from “{{way}}”, set to ask or go to {{place}}. The original way stays as it is.
copy.steps: Steps that ask or go to {{place}}: {{steps}}
copy.noSteps: No step asks {{place}} yet (choose it in a step’s “who to ask” or “fixed place”).
copy.facts: Hours, cost, deadlines and how long a reply takes aren’t copied from the old place — they’re left blank. Check {{place}}’s page and enter them (a cost you don’t know can stay “Not known”).
copy.coversAskNote: The old place’s hours aren’t used, so please choose. Choosing all of it doesn’t mean they have agreed.
copy.registrationUnsureNote: This won’t be saved while you’re unsure whether registration is needed (it would look like a way with no prerequisite).
copy.noOwnRegistration: Registration at {{place}} isn’t in your household information yet. If this place needs its own registration, add it from “Look around us” under nearby resources first (if it’s the same registration as another, choose that above).
copy.missing: Some fields are still empty or not chosen: the name, steps, by when, how long a reply takes, the hours it covers, and advance registration at this place.

wayIdeas.title: Ideas for ways
wayIdeas.intro: Claude suggests ways to get this to-do done. The ideas are inferred. Nothing changes until you put one into the form, correct it, and save it after seeing what the change would do.
wayIdeas.outside: Claude doesn’t fill in prices, how quickly others reply, deadline rules, or the hours something can cover (these are outside the family; you enter them in the form).
wayIdeas.wordsHint: e.g. Grandma might be able to help. I could take the afternoon off.
wayIdeas.privacy: When you press the button, this to-do (what, when, place and the original text), your thoughts above, the names of the adults, helpers and places, and the names of current ways and their steps are sent to Anthropic’s Claude API. Other household details (the usual week, children, opening hours and so on) are not sent. But anything written in the text and names that are sent (such as names, addresses or schedules) is sent as written. In this demo the ideas are kept only in the server’s memory.
wayIdeas.privacyTrial: This is a trial household. Use made-up family details only. When you press the button, this to-do (what, when, place and the original text), your thoughts above, the names of the adults, helpers and places, and the names of current ways and their steps are sent to Anthropic’s Claude API. Other household details (the usual week, children, opening hours and so on) are not sent. But anything written in the text and names that are sent (such as names, addresses or schedules) is sent as written. The ideas and your thoughts are not saved in the household’s records (they’re kept briefly in the server’s memory).
wayIdeas.working: Claude is thinking (this can take a few tens of seconds).
wayIdeas.busy: Another reading is in progress. Wait a moment, then press again.
wayIdeas.limit: You’ve used up the ideas available. For this demo, “Start over” makes a new demo. The server-wide limit resets the next day (UTC).
wayIdeas.limitTrial: Ideas aren’t available right now (what would be sent is too long, or the limit was reached; the limit resets at 9:00 Japan time).
wayIdeas.uncertain: We couldn’t tell the result (no reply arrived). Press again to check the result of the earlier request.
wayIdeas.lost: The server no longer knows the result of the earlier request. Press again to get new ideas (this counts as one use).
wayIdeas.stale: This to-do or the household’s records changed while Claude was thinking. Press again.
wayIdeas.needGone: This to-do is no longer needed or can’t be found.
wayIdeas.testOnly: This household can’t use this (only trial households can).
wayIdeas.failed: Couldn’t get ideas. Wait a moment and try again.
wayIdeas.unavailable: Ideas from Claude aren’t available here.
wayIdeas.outdated: The ideas below were made for earlier details of this to-do, or in another language. To put one into the form, get ideas again.
wayIdeas.reuseLabel: A current way may be enough
wayIdeas.reuseBack: Go back to the to-do and choose it

memberDay.title: Just this day

said.hypothetical: Read as a what-if. Nothing is recorded here.
said.undetermined: We couldn't tell whether this is a real plan or a what-if, so we calculate it as a what-if. Nothing is recorded.
said.actual: Read as a change to that day. You can see the calculation before deciding whether to record it.

ask.person: We couldn't tell whose day this is. Choose below.
ask.date: We couldn't tell which day (past days aren't calculated). Enter the date below.
ask.weekday: The date and the weekday don't match. Check the date below.
ask.time: We couldn't tell the time. Enter it below (we don't guess times).
ask.offWithTime: We couldn't tell whether it's a whole day off or only the time you mentioned at home. Choose “Day off” or “Home for a while” below.

memberDay.heardText: You said: “{{text}}” (check that the details below match)

premise.said: What we read from your message (you can edit it)

problem.noDay: No usual-week plan is registered for this person on this weekday.
problem.badTime: Check the times (start before end; work must end after it starts).
problem.outsideDay: That time doesn't connect to this day's plan (use a time within the day or right next to it).
problem.travel: Making this time “home” would need travel to and from work or the pick-up place that we can't work out, so we don't calculate it. If work ends earlier or later, choose “Work end time”; if you don't go to work, choose “Day off”.
problem.noWork: There's no work on this day, so the work end time can't change.
problem.pickup: This day has a pick-up after work. What happens to the pick-up when work ends at a different time (going late, someone covering, picking up early) can't be calculated yet. Edit the usual week in Home, or choose “Day off”.
problem.overnight: Plans past midnight can't be calculated yet.
problem.afterWork: On this day, there's a plan after work other than going home (such as time out), or the way home would run into it. What happens to that plan when work ends at a different time isn't known, so it isn't calculated. Change that plan first (for example with “Out for a while”), or choose “Day off”.

assumed.label: Assumptions we added
assumed.off: We calculate as if this person is home all day and can look after the child (“Home” blocks count as time someone can look after the child). Their usual work, commute, outings and pick-ups are skipped that day.
assumed.home: We calculate as if this person is home and can look after the child during that time. The rest of the day stays as usual.
assumed.away: We calculate as if this person is out during that time. Include where they go and the travel in this time. The rest of the day stays as usual.
assumed.late: Only the commute home right after work moves earlier or later, keeping its usual length. Plans after you get home stay where they are.
assumed.notRecorded: Seeing the calculation doesn't record anything.

days.label: This person's day
days.backToUsual: Remove the recorded day and go back to the usual day.

memberDay.restore: Go back to usual and record
memberDay.recordNote: Recording changes only this day (the same weekday before and after stays the same). If the plan changed after you looked, we recalculate and show it again instead of recording.
memberDay.toUsual: Set this day back to usual

resources.label: Around us
resources.used: Facilities and services near home that your family added, and what must be done before using them (such as registering in advance). You enter whether it’s done (research alone never marks it done). Options needing an advance step not confirmed as done are not recommended.

source.webUnchecked: Source page: {{title}} (read on {{when}}; the quote was not checked against the page text)

preparation.noLead: How many days ahead hasn’t been confirmed (check early)

survey.decide: Decide how your family treats it
survey.again: Ask Claude to look again now (about a minute)
survey.intro: Claude searches the web for places near home that can look after your children or lend a hand (sick-child care, temporary childcare, family support) and reads their pages. Only what your family decides to add goes into your household information.
survey.working: Looking… (when Claude looks now, it takes about a minute)
survey.recordedAt: What Claude found around {{area}} on {{when}}, saved for this demo (the quotes were checked then).
survey.checkedNote: Shown here are only places whose quote appears in the text of a page Claude read (compared after normalizing character width and spaces). That checks the words are on the page — not that the page is official or still correct. Please check the link. Claude’s summaries are in Japanese (the survey asks Claude in Japanese); quotes are in the page’s own words.
survey.dropped: {{count}} more are not shown because they couldn’t be checked ({{reasons}}).

reason.notRead: {{count}} whose page text couldn’t be read
reason.quoteNotFound: {{count}} whose quote wasn’t in the page text
reason.kind: {{count}} of a kind we didn’t ask for

registration.required: Claude’s reading: you must register in advance before using it (page says: “{{quote}}”). Only the words on the page were checked, not their meaning.
registration.notRequired: Claude’s reading: no advance registration needed (page says: “{{quote}}”). Only the words on the page were checked, not their meaning.
registration.notRead: In Claude’s reading, the page says nothing about advance registration (that doesn’t mean none is needed).

survey.lead: The page says “{{quote}}” (what the number of days refers to hasn’t been checked, so it isn’t used as a deadline).
survey.ways: Ways that need this registration first (this only adds the prerequisite — who you ask and where you go stay the same)

survey.samePlace: It’s the same place as “{{name}}” in our household information
survey.samePlaceNot: Unless you confirm it’s the same place, it’s added without a place (it can’t be who you ask or where you go in a way).

copy.noPlace: It isn’t linked to a place, so it can’t be who you ask or where you go in a way.
